verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 tag-similarity sustains cooperation (no reciprocity): mean donation rate in [0.55, 0.85] at P=3

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 dominant tag cluster forms: time-averaged modal-tag-cluster share >= 0.6 (|tau-modal|<=0.01)

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 cooperation is intermittent (waves of tolerance): CV(donation rate) >= 0.1 AND crash-and-recover in a majority of seeds
